book.title: ME LOMA ꞌIDI LETA PAULO ꞌIꞌETOLADINA

content: Taudi ꞌidi emisa nenetadi tada lemedi
Yaisigedi ꞌaboꞌada ꞌida emisa waiwaina, ꞌilobweneda be gosedao taudi ꞌidi emisa nenetadi tada lemedi, ta geyaꞌabo taudamo manuda tanuwanuwa.
ꞌEnega ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna ꞌilobweneda be gosedao tada lemedi be ꞌenega ꞌidi emisa ꞌida sinabwa.

Manuna Keliso wate nadigega nigeya taunamo manuna ꞌinuwanuwa, ta esi ꞌana mwau nidi niꞌatu Buki Tabu ꞌena ꞌisimanena, ꞌigwae, “Tomotai nidi taudi siꞌawaꞌawa toꞌumaliyemuya, ꞌaboꞌagu wate ꞌeguya ona nidi siꞌinanedi.”
Ta wate ꞌaina ꞌebeꞌitao yaudi Buki Tabu ꞌena simiyami Yaubada ꞌina lemao manudi, ta ꞌabo ꞌebeꞌita nidi taemisedi, tada eꞌalamaꞌiꞌitana ma ida nuwayaina be ꞌaene maꞌetamo ꞌetoseyana tada loba.
ꞌEnega tanuwaꞌiꞌisi ꞌaene Yaubada tauna ꞌalamaꞌiꞌita be giepaꞌala ꞌalena, ꞌenega tauna sawesawenaya be ꞌigiepaꞌalida be tada nuwanuwa ꞌebweuna, nadigega Yesu Keliso ꞌina nuwanuwa,
be ꞌenega maiboꞌada nuwanuwa ꞌebweuna ꞌenega Yaubada tada tupu, tauna ꞌida Yaubada, ta wate ꞌida ꞌInapwana Yesu Keliso tamana.
Tetela boboꞌana gete ꞌomi nigeya me Yudia ꞌemiya
ꞌEnega gosemiyao ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna wada bwauyedi ꞌimi egosigosiyanao ꞌediya, nadigega Yesu Keliso ꞌaboꞌada ꞌiegosigosiyaneda, be ꞌimi egosigosiyana boboꞌana ꞌenega Yaubada ꞌana tupu ꞌida sinabwa.
Ta wada nuwaꞌiꞌisi ꞌaene Keliso wate me Yudia ꞌediya ꞌietoguinuwa, be ꞌenega Yaubada ꞌina onaupaupa nina gimi ꞌinapwanao ꞌediya ꞌana ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌida apwesa,

ta wate ꞌaene taudi nigeya me Yudia sena yauyaudi ꞌediya simiyami, Yaubada sida tupu ꞌina ꞌatenuwaꞌoleꞌole ꞌediya manuna. Manuna ꞌebweu ꞌetoladi Buki Tabu ꞌena ꞌigwae, “Gete ꞌalena ꞌenega sena yauyaudi maꞌegwao ꞌada tupuyo, ta wate ꞌamu esana manuna ꞌada wali tuputupu ꞌemuya.”
Ta wate ꞌigwae, “Sena maiboꞌana ꞌediya wamiyamiya, Yaubada ꞌina tomotaiyao maꞌemiyao wada egwausowala.”
Ta wate ꞌigwae, “ꞌOmi nigeya me Yudia, ꞌInapwana nina wada tupu, ta wate maiboꞌami wada ꞌawaboboꞌane.”
Wate nadigega Aisea ꞌina buki ꞌena ꞌigwae, “ꞌIabe Desi ꞌina boda ꞌenega ꞌebweu tai ꞌimama be sena maiboꞌana ꞌediya ꞌietoloina, be taudi nigeya me Yudia sida emise ꞌaene tauna ꞌida ꞌetoseyedi.”

Ta onaꞌaiꞌaila, Yaubada namo ma ꞌana emisa, manuna taunamo ꞌenega lema boboꞌadi talobalobadi, ꞌenega nuwanuwagu be ma imi gwausowala wada emisa ꞌaene ꞌimi miya sida boboꞌana, ta wate Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌina waiwaiyega ꞌimi emisao nidi ꞌida giesinabwa ꞌaiꞌailidi.
Paulo ꞌina loguguya manuna
Gosegwao, niꞌatu yamwalatoi ꞌaiꞌailimi ꞌaene ꞌomi tomota boboꞌami ta sinasinapumi, ꞌenega sawesawemiya be ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna ꞌenaya wada eꞌita.
Ta ma igu ꞌatepatu ꞌimi leta gete yaꞌetoladinawa be ꞌenega ꞌaina yage wada nuwaꞌiꞌisidi, manuna ꞌigu paisewa gete Yaubada ꞌiꞌebwaꞌegu,

be ꞌaene Yesu Keliso manuna yada etosimana ꞌomi nigeya me Yudia ꞌemiya. ꞌIgu paisewa gete ꞌena ꞌatuwa nadigega taliya yaguiguinuwe be ꞌenega Yesu tetelina wada nono, be muliyega yada ꞌebwayaemi Yaubada ꞌenaya, manuna Yaluyaluwa Tabuna niꞌatu ꞌigieꞌesasemi ga Yaubada manumi ꞌigwausowala sinabwana.
Onaꞌaiꞌaila, ma igu gwausowala Yaubada ꞌina guinuwa yaguiguinuwe, manuna Yesu Keliso maꞌiyagu ꞌapaipaisewa.

ꞌEnega ꞌaboꞌagu namo ꞌigu paisewa manudi gete tuga yasimasimanedi ꞌemiya, ta nigeya wate mali tomota ꞌidi paisewa manudi. Ta yasimana palupalu ꞌemiya ꞌigu loguguyao sena apwesaya ꞌediya sinonodi, ga simuliyedi, manuna Yesu Keliso ꞌina waiwai ꞌeguya ꞌimiyami,
ta wate ꞌigu guinuwao waiwaidi ta ꞌebe nuwaowana siꞌitedi, manuna Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌina waiwaiyega Keliso tetelina yaguguya sakowasiyena Yelusalemega ga ꞌana laba yamai Ililikami ꞌenaya.
Manuna nuwanuwagu be sena auwaudi namo ꞌediya yada gimi loguguya, taudi sena nidi nigeya Keliso tetelina sinoono, manuna geya nuwagu be mali tologuguyao ꞌidi guinuwa yaloeposeyane.
Manuna Buki Tabu ꞌina simana ꞌigwae, “Yaisigedi taudi Toꞌetoseyana nina tetelina nigeya sida nonona, ꞌiabe sinono, be tauna manuna sida nuwasabwalena.”
Paulo nuwanuwana me Loma ꞌida ayausidi
Gete ꞌalena ꞌenega nigeya yada ayausimi. Ta onaꞌaiꞌaila, yakwala yau wawasae ꞌediya nuwanuwagu be yayausimi, ta saꞌi nigeya sawesaweguya. Ta niꞌatu gete ꞌigu paisewao nidi niꞌatu yalosalonidi,
ꞌenega nai gete tuga yada gimiyausimi, be tupwana maꞌemiya tada egwausowala, be muliyega waegelugu be yatatauya Sipeini.
Ta esi muliyega be yawawa ꞌemiya, nuwanuwagu be nugana yatatauya Yelusalema be toekalesiyao ꞌadi lema, nate me Esia ꞌidi ꞌebwayadaita, yada ꞌebwaꞌedi.
Manuna me Masidonia be me Gilisi nidi nuwanuwadi be ꞌidi ꞌebwayadaita nina yada ꞌebwaya toekalesiyao gomagomabesodi Yelusalema ꞌenaya ꞌediya,

manuna taudimo gete nadigega ꞌidi nuwanuwa. Onaꞌaiꞌaila, ꞌilobwenena be me Yelusalema ꞌadi lema sida loba me Esia ꞌediyega, manuna nugana me Yelusalema ꞌediyega Keliso tetelina me Esia nidi sinonona, yaluyaluwadi ꞌadi lema manuna, ꞌenega taudi saꞌi baleꞌu gwegwenao siꞌebwaꞌebwaya me Yelusalema ꞌediya.

ꞌEnega gete namo ꞌigu paisewa nina yada losaloni, nate ꞌebwayadaita nina gete me Yelusalema yada ꞌebwaꞌedi, be muliyega yawawa ꞌemiya be yayausimi, be ꞌenega ꞌemiyega yada gelu limana be yatatauya Sipeini ꞌena.
Ta yanuwayaina ꞌaene ꞌigu ayausa ꞌemiya boboꞌana, manuna Keliso ꞌina oboboma sinabwana ꞌeguya ꞌimiyami, ꞌenega ꞌiabe taegwausowala leleleya.
Gosegwao, ꞌida ꞌInapwana Yesu Keliso ꞌana esanega ta Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌina obobomega, ꞌemiya yasidasida waiwai be ꞌomi maꞌegwao Yaubada ꞌena tada sidasida,

taudi Yesu ꞌana toguitoyasao Yudia ꞌenaya manudi, be ꞌenega geyaꞌabo sigiegie toꞌumaliyegu, be wate toekalesiyao nidi gomagomabesodi Yelusalema ꞌenaya manudi, be ꞌaene ꞌebwayadaita getei yatautauye manuna sida gwausowala, ta geyaꞌabo sida guiguitoyase,
be ꞌenega ꞌabo Yaubada ꞌina nuwena gete nadigega, ꞌiabe ma igu gwausowala yawawa ꞌemiya, be nada tupwana ꞌemiya yaeyawaiꞌata.
Yaubada maꞌemi, tauna nuwasiwalowa ꞌalena. Eimeni.
